sections.title: The ALTER you forgot
body: Change a table file, then remember to write the matching ALTER, in the right order, without missing a default or a constraint. Every step is a chance to get it slightly wrong.
sections.caption: Every forgotten ALTER detail piles onto the checklist.

sections.title: Design, release, snapshot
body: Before release, dbd reconcile applies the design to a development database in place. dbd release writes a baseline snapshot and locks in the snapshot-and-migration workflow. From then on, dbd snapshot captures the schema and generates the migration SQL from the difference.

code.text:
dbd release            # baseline, then snapshots only
# …edit ddl files…
dbd snapshot           # capture + generate migration SQL
dbd migrate --status   # where each database stands

sections.caption: Two snapshots generate the migration SQL between them.

sections.title: The diff is the migration
body: You review one thing, the change to the design, and the migration follows from it.
sections.caption: One status table shows where each database stands.

takeaway: You review the design change. The migration follows.
